description: Run a read-only configurable funnel recipe using one GA4 report per eventName/pagePath step and return simple step counts.

datePreset.description: Named reporting period. Use the custom date range when you need exact start and end dates.

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (today, yesterday)

metric.description: Metric used for the analysis; use a name from the platform metric catalogue.

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or relative (7daysAgo, yesterday)

steps.description: Ordered funnel steps. Each step needs eventName or pagePath.

eventName.description: GA4 eventName to count for this step

matchType.description: String match type for pagePath. eventName always uses EXACT.

name.description: Optional display name for this funnel step

pagePath.description: GA4 pagePath to count for this step

name: ga4_run_funnel_recipe

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: ga4 run funnel recipe
